attack-on-titan.notes: Ch 34 is split: S1 finale adapts it and S2 ep 1 opens with its remainder.

shingeki-no-kyojin-2.notes: S2 finale also opens ch 51; S3 starts at ch 51.

shingeki-no-kyojin-3.notes: Adapted out of order in places; the finale also uses flash-forward pages from ch 84.

shingeki-no-kyojin-the-final-season.notes: Finale touches the start of ch 117; Part 2 re-covers parts of ch 115-116 before continuing from ch 117.

shingeki-no-kyojin-the-final-season-part.notes: Ep 1 re-adapts parts of ch 115-116. The two 'THE FINAL CHAPTERS' specials (not in this list) adapt ch 131-139, the end of the manga.

boku-no-hero-academia.notes: S1 finale covers most of ch 21; S2 ep 1 finishes it.

boku-no-hero-academia-2nd-season.notes: S2 finale adapts the first pages of ch 70; S3 picks up mid-ch 70.

boku-no-hero-academia-3rd-season.notes: S3 ep 1 is mostly anime-original (uses parts of bonus ch 49.5).

boku-no-hero-academia-4th-season.notes: S4 ep 1 is anime-original; finale previews a few pages of ch 192-193.

boku-no-hero-academia-5th-season.notes: Adapted out of order: ch 241-255 air before the flashback My Villain Academia arc (ch 218-240). Finale touches ch 258; S6 starts there.

boku-no-hero-academia-6th-season.notes: MangaUpdates lists the end as ch 327; the fandom wiki and Anime Filler Guide both put the finale at ch 326-328, so 328 used.

boku-no-hero-academia-final-season.notes: Adaptation complete. The epilogue ch 431 (added in vol 42) is adapted separately as the 'More' OVA per MangaUpdates.

one-punch-man.notes: Murata (Young Jump) manga numbering. MangaUpdates puts the S1/S2 split at 36/37; the fandom wiki and Anime Filler Guide both use 37/38.

one-punch-man-3.notes: Finale adapts ch 115 plus a few pages of ch 116 and 117 (fandom wiki); Anime Filler Guide says ch 116, MangaUpdates says ch 115. Start reading at ch 116 to be safe. Season 3 Part 2 is due in 2027.

death-note.notes: Second half (after about ch 59) is abridged and the ending is changed. The epilogue ch 108 is not adapted, so read ch 108 after the anime.

fullmetal-alchemist-brotherhood.notes: Adapts the whole manga. Vols 1-7 and 15 are abridged and ch 3-4 skipped (MangaUpdates); ep 1 is anime-original.

hunter-x-hunter-2011.notes: Ends with the Election arc. Ch 340 starts the Dark Continent Expedition (manga ongoing, irregular).

kimetsu-no-yaiba.notes: Ch 54-66 (Mugen Train) are covered by the Mugen Train film or the 7-episode Mugen Train Arc TV version (not in this list) before Entertainment District.

kimetsu-no-yaiba-yuukaku-hen.notes: Entertainment District arc only. Ch 54-66 are in the Mugen Train film / TV arc.

Kimetsu-no-Yaiba-Hashira-Geikohen.notes: Continues in the Infinity Castle film trilogy. Part 1 (2025) adapts ch 140 to about ch 156-157 (MangaUpdates says 156, Anime Filler Guide 157).

nanatsu-no-taizai.notes: Finale also previews ch 108. Revival of the Commandments ep 1 re-covers ch 102-103.

nanatsu-no-taizai-imashime-no-fukkatsu.notes: Episode 1 also re-covers ch 102-103. Finale includes extra ch 11-12.

nanatsu-no-taizai-kamigami-no-gekirin.notes: Heavily reordered. The finale borrows pages from ch 272 and 285; Dragon's Judgement starts at ch 268.

nanatsu-no-taizai-fundo-no-shinpan.notes: Adaptation complete. The sequel manga Four Knights of the Apocalypse is a separate series.

ansatsu-kyoushitsu-tv.notes: Ep 22 is titled after a much later chapter but adapts ch 71-73.

ansatsu-kyoushitsu-tv-2.notes: Adaptation complete, ending with the final ch 180. MangaUpdates lists the end as 184 counting extra chapters and OVA material.

haikyuu.notes: S2 ep 1 opens by revisiting part of ch 71.

haikyuu-karasuno-koukou-vs-shiratorizawa.notes: Ch 191-206 are not in the TV series. They are adapted in the OVAs 'Land vs. Air' (ch 190-199) and 'The Path of the Ball'. To the Top starts at ch 207 (the S3 finale previews it).

haikyuu-to-the-top-2.notes: The film 'The Dumpster Battle' (2024) adapts ch 293 to about ch 325-326 (MangaUpdates says 325, Anime Filler Guide 326).

jujutsu-kaisen.notes: The film Jujutsu Kaisen 0 adapts the prequel volume 0 (separate from the main chapter numbering).

jujutsu-kaisen-2.notes: Opens with the Gojo's Past arc (ch 65-79); ch 64 is adapted in ep 30. Finale previews pages of ch 138-139.

Jujutsu-Kaisen-3.notes: Finale adapts only a few pages of ch 181 (MangaUpdates says up to p. 14), so start at ch 181.

naruto.notes: Canon ends at ep 135 (ch 238); eps 136-220 are filler. Ch 239-244 (Kakashi Gaiden) are adapted in Shippuden eps 119-120, and Shippuden's main story starts at ch 245.

naruto-shippuden.notes: Ch 239-244 (Kakashi Gaiden) appear in eps 119-120. Heavy filler. The epilogue ch 700 is adapted in Boruto ep 24 per MangaUpdates; Narutopedia ties it to Shippuden ep 500. Sources differ, so ch 700 is given as the place to continue.

yakusoku-no-neverland.notes: Season 2 drops whole arcs and changes the story. Readers should continue from ch 38, not from where S2 ends.

tokyo-ghoul.notes: Abridged and reordered, with parts of ch 54-61 omitted. √A (S2) leaves the manga here and is mostly original, so readers continue from Tokyo Ghoul ch 67. Anime Filler Guide's season header says ch 69 because it counts √A's first episode, which uses ch 67 and 69 onward (skipping 68). Its per-episode table, the fandom wiki (ep 12 = ch 61-66) and MangaUpdates all end Season 1 at ch 66; √A diverges from ch 67, so read on from there.

tokyo-ghoul-re.notes: Uses Tokyo Ghoul:re's own chapter numbering. Heavily abridged with changes. Ch 59 is skipped (:re 2 starts at ch 60).

tokyo-ghoul-re-2.notes: Uses Tokyo Ghoul:re's own chapter numbering. Covers the rest of :re to the final ch 179, heavily compressed with changes. The manga is the fuller version.

noragami.notes: Eps 10 (mostly), 11 and 12 are an anime-original ending. Aragoto ignores it and its ep 1 revisits ch 12 before continuing from ch 13.

noragami-aragoto.notes: TV ends at ch 39, so start at ch 40. MangaUpdates notes an OAD later adapts ch 41 while skipping ch 40.

shokugeki-no-souma-ni-no-sara.notes: Ch 118-119 are covered by an OVA (MangaUpdates). Season 3 starts at ch 120.

shokugeki-no-souma-san-no-sara.notes: First cour of Season 3. The finale mixes in ch 149-151 out of order.

shokugeki-no-souma-shin-no-sara.notes: MangaUpdates ends it at ch 264; another guide says 263. 264 used. Season 5 skips ch 265-272, so read those after this season.

shokugeki-no-souma-gou-no-sara.notes: Skips ch 265-272 and heavily abridges the BLUE arc, with anime-only changes. The manga's main story ends at ch 315. Readers wanting the full version should read ch 265-315.

boku-dake-ga-inai-machi.notes: Covers the whole story, but the last episodes condense and change vol 6-8 (from about ch 36). MangaUpdates also lists ch 28-29, 32 and 34-35 as skipped or abridged. The side-story volume 9 (ERASED Re) is not adapted. To read the manga's version of the ending, start around ch 36.

mob-psycho-100-ii.notes: Some chapters adapted out of order (e.g. ch 57 in ep 1).

sword-art-online.notes: Aincrad (vol 1, plus side stories from vol 2) and Fairy Dance (vols 3-4).

sword-art-online-ii.notes: Phantom Bullet (vols 5-6), then Calibur (only that story is adapted from vol 8), then Mother's Rosario (vol 7). The Ordinal Scale film is an original story.

sword-art-online-alicization-war-of-unde.notes: MAL guide says vols 15-16, but ANN's review places the 2nd cour's opening around pp. 103-141 of vol 17. So this cour also covers the first ~100 pages of vol 17. Continue from vol 17.
Starts partway into vol 17 and finishes Alicization with vol 18. Unadapted material follows (Moon Cradle, then Unital Ring); not checked against two sources.

re-zero-kara-hajimeru-isekai-seikatsu.notes: Arcs 1-3. The end of vol 9 (interlude onward) opens Season 2.

re-zero-kara-hajimeru-isekai-seikatsu-2.notes: First half of Arc 4. Ep 1 also adapts the end of vol 9. Ends partway into vol 13 (ch 1-2), so continue from vol 13. The part split is from the fandom wiki only; Wikipedia gives vols 10-15 for the whole season.

rezero-season-2-part-2.notes: Second half of Arc 4, from vol 13 (ch 2 onward) to the end of vol 15. The end point is confirmed by two sources; the start point only by the fandom wiki.

re-zero-kara-hajimeru-isekai-seikatsu-3.notes: Arc 5. The last chapter of vol 20 is adapted at the start of Season 4, so continue from late vol 20 (or vol 21).

re-zero-kara-hajimeru-isekai-seikatsu-4.notes: Arc 6. Ep 1 also adapts the final chapter of vol 20. Finale adapts vol 25 ch 9-10; continue from vol 26 (Arc 7).

no-game-no-life.notes: The film No Game No Life: Zero adapts vol 6, a prequel.

toradora.notes: Covers the whole story. The anime finished alongside the final volume, cuts material, and its ending differs in details from vol 10.

danjo-no-yuujou-wa-seiritsu-suru-iya-shi.notes: One source only (Where Does the Anime Leave Off: start at vol 4). The anime rushes the novels and gives the season a more conclusive ending. Vol 4 is published in two parts.

maou-sama-retry-r.notes: Chapters are from the sequel manga Demon Lord, Retry! R. Eps 1-3 mostly finish the original manga (vol 4 ch 19 to vol 5 ch 25). The end point rests on MangaUpdates alone; the fan wiki has ep 11 at R ch 26-27.

kanpeki-sugite-kawai-ge-ga-nai-to-konyak.notes: Eps 1-10 adapt vol 1; eps 11-12 squeeze vol 2 into two episodes, so vol 2 is worth reading before vol 3.

niwatori-fighter.notes: Skips ch 3-4 and 11. The finale touches the end of ch 31 but mostly skips it; continue from ch 31.

youkai-gakkou-no-sensei-hajimemashita.franchise: A Terrified Teacher at Ghoul School!
youkai-gakkou-no-sensei-hajimemashita.notes: Two cours (Oct 2024-Mar 2025), adapted out of order with many chapters skipped. MangaUpdates ends it at ch 77; another guide says ch 78.

chichi-wa-eiyuu-haha-wa-seirei-musume-no.franchise: Reincarnated as the Daughter of the Legendary Hero and the Queen of Spirits
chichi-wa-eiyuu-haha-wa-seirei-musume-no.notes: Novel volumes rest on one source (Where Does the Anime Leave Off). MangaUpdates puts the end at manga vol 7 ch 38.

rock-wa-lady-no-tashina-mideshite.notes: Sources disagree: one guide says start at ch 30 (the anime ends differently after the concert), MangaUpdates ends it at ch 30, Animeoshi at ch 26. Both main sources put the end in vol 5.

yasei-no-last-boss-ga-arawareta.notes: Season 1. Season 2 airs from Oct 2026. One weaker guide claims vols 1-3.

tensei-akujo-no-kuro-rekishi.franchise: The Dark History of the Reincarnated Villainess
tensei-akujo-no-kuro-rekishi.notes: Ends with the elf village vampire arc (Death Flags 14-18). Ep 13 adapts bonus chapters from the Ex volume. Death Flag 19 (Iana goes to Ginoford's family home) starts the next arc.

chitose-kun-wa-ramune-bin-no-naka.franchise: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle
chitose-kun-wa-ramune-bin-no-naka.notes: First cour (eps 1-13). Eps 11-13 finish the vol 3 Asuka arc. The second cour (from Oct 13, 2026) starts at vol 4.

watashi-wo-tabetai-hitodenashi.franchise: This Monster Wants to Eat Me
watashi-wo-tabetai-hitodenashi.notes: Covers vols 1-7. The finale leaves out the last pages of ch 31. The range rests on two where-does-the-anime-end guides; no chapter-by-episode list was found to check it against.

kakuriyo-no-yadomeshi-2nd-season.notes: Season 1 covers vols 1-5; the author said season 2 starts at vol 6. The end at vol 8 (the Northern Land arc) comes from matching episode titles to the wiki's volume summaries on one wiki only.

kiseijuu.notes: Covers the whole manga (64 chapters, 10 volumes), moved to the 2010s. The finale adapts ch 63-64.

fairy-tail-2018.notes: Final Series (eps 278-328): the end of the Avatar arc and the Alvarez Empire arc, through the last chapter. The sequel manga Fairy Tail: 100 Years Quest has its own anime.

mirai-nikki-tv.notes: Covers the whole manga (59 chapters, 12 volumes). The last pages of ch 59 (the epilogue) are left out; the Redial OVA covers them.

ao-no-exorcist.notes: Eps 1-17 loosely follow ch 1-15; eps 18-25 are an anime-original story and ending. Kyoto Saga (S2) ignores them and resumes the manga, so continue from ch 16.

dr-stone.notes: The S1 finale adapts most of ch 60; S2 (Stone Wars) opens with its last pages and continues from ch 61.

kono-subarashii-sekai-ni-shukufuku-wo.notes: Vol 1 and vol 2 (ending with the Destroyer). Season 2 starts at vol 3.

kono-subarashii-sekai-ni-shukufuku-wo-2.notes: Vols 3-4. The film Legend of Crimson adapts vol 5, so film viewers continue from vol 6.

fairy-tail.notes: 2009 series (eps 1-175), ending mid Grand Magic Games. Ch 298-299 (Ryuzetsu Land) are adapted as OVA 5; the 2014 series resumes at ch 300.

kaguya-sama-wa-kokurasetai-tensai-tachi-.notes: Adapted out of order and selectively: ep 12 ends with ch 44-46, and skipped earlier chapters (e.g. ch 30) turn up in S2. The second source is a guide table only.

the-devil-is-a-part-timer.notes: Vol 1 and vol 2 (ending with the Sariel fight). Season 2 (2022) starts at vol 3 with Alas Ramus.

durarara.notes: Covers the first three novels; the finale adapts vol 3.

hunter-x-hunter.notes: 1999 TV series (62 eps), stopping mid Yorknew City; ep 62 also takes a few pages of ch 102. The 1999 OVAs continue from ch 102 through Greed Island (ch 184).

seishun-buta-yarou-wa-bunny-girl-senpai-.notes: The TV series adapts vols 1-5. The film Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dreaming Girl adapts vols 6-7, so film viewers continue from vol 8.

bleach.notes: Original series (eps 1-366), ending with the Lost Agent arc. Ch 480 starts the Thousand-Year Blood War arc, adapted by the 2022 series.

hyouka.notes: Covers the first four Classic Literature Club books (vol 4 is the short-story collection The Doll That Took a Detour). Vols 5-6 are unadapted. From guides and episode titles; no per-episode source list.
